title: Tighten the granularity and pace-floor assertions in step_chazara_goal_l1_test.dart and edit_track_and_detail_l1_test.dart to match what their own titles/comments claim

evidence.quote:
// Just verifying the value "1" is visible (loading completed).
        expect(find.text('1'), findsWidgets);

why: The chazara-goal test titled 'selecting coarse (perek) emits paceGranularity=perek' taps the 'Perakim' segment then only asserts goal.rawLearningUnit isNotNull — but _paceGranularity is set to a non-null default in initState() before any tap, so the assertion passes identically whether or not the tap actually changed anything. The edit-track test titled 'pace increment button is disabled when paceValue is 1 (minimum)' never inspects the stepper button's onPressed at all (its own comment admits 'Just verifying the value "1" is visible') — floor enforcement for EditTrackScreen's pace stepper is untested anywhere in the tree (grepped for 'remove_rounded'/'onPressed.*isNull' in the sibling edit_track_screen_l1_test.dart: no match).
recommendation: Assert goal.rawLearningUnit equals the coarse key's storage value ('perek') rather than isNotNull. In the edit-track test, find the decrement IconButton (ancestor of Icons.remove_rounded) and assert its onPressed is null at paceValue==1, then non-null after an increment.
acceptance_criteria: Granularity test asserts goal.rawLearningUnit == the expected coarse key, not just non-null
Pace-floor test asserts tester.widget<IconButton>(...).onPressed is null at value 1 and non-null after incrementing
